evidence_items.explanation: The report attributes ongoing customer-service automation to Klarna spokesperson Clare Nordstrom, contradicting the categorical task-automation denial. It also reports renewed human recruitment and quality concerns; the volume figure is company-reported and does not measure net returns or successful resolution of every inquiry.

This randomized study supplies material evidence that useful productivity gains were not universal. June marks the end of its February–June study window; because that window extends beyond the target quarter, and the study does not test a specified marketing promise, it is context rather than decisive support.
